damage-runtime.reason: Combat damage runs in tactics.ts, which applies its own range and armor multipliers to every hit; adopt the shared damage table.

damage-target-unknown.reason: The tactical combat path never validates a target's resistance profile; adopt the shared damage table with its unknown-target refusal.

game-save.reason: The campaign track, stores and preferences are saved as bespoke sections at campaign beats; adopt the shared save document.

game-save-digest.reason: The campaign save has no state digest for the restore tests; adopt the shared save document's digest.

transaction-ledger.reason: The economy moves gold and lumber through tuning constants and systems.ts with no recorded reason; adopt the shared transaction ledger.
